methodology.execution: One fresh subprocess at a time; code order alternates within paired jobs.
methodology.timing: Solve wall and process CPU exclude imports/setup/validation; process CPU includes threads.
methodology.objective: miss urgent, miss urgent+high, miss total, then profile-specific terms; morning uses engineers, metres
methodology.reference: Same saved OR-Tools plan if requested; no simulated events or completed jobs.
methodology.fleets: Independent permutations preserve skills, modes and start/shift bundle marginals; stock stays with engineer IDs.
methodology.issued: Stock from original published plan, fixed before fleet variants. Variants are a search stress, not an executed workday.
methodology.seeds: OR-Tools once per case/budget/profile; wall-clock stopping prevents bitwise determinism.
methodology.bounds: No optimality claim; each returned plan independently validated.
